description: email.rs line 656-668: find_immutable_patch_key returns Option<String> by calling field.to_string() on a &'static str from IMMUTABLE_EMAIL_FIELDS. The field variable is already &'static str (it comes from &[&str] constant), so the function signature should return Option<&'static str> and return Some(field) directly. The current code allocates a String on every hit — this runs on every Email/set update and Email/copy onSuccessUpdateOriginal patch. Returning &'static str is cleaner, cheaper, and the lifetime is provably correct.
title: find_immutable_patch_key returns Option<String> instead of Option<&'static str>
